current.text: Bryant is the backup center behind Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen. He is the only real backup big, with Ernest Udeh Jr. and Khalifa Diop behind him.
He is projected as the 10th man in the Cleveland rotation.
Cleveland's center depth is so poor that he should play most nights.
He is a stash in roto, weekly, deep bench and games-cap leagues.
If both Allen and Mobley were out, he could be a top 50 to 60 player.
Cleveland has the most back-to-backs in the league.
With our March 28 end, Cleveland plays 4, 3 and then 2 games in the fantasy playoff weeks. The final week is a two-game week.

durable.text: Experts call him a bad player in real life. He is inconsistent, with bad shooting and weak defense at times.
He gets very few steals, a clear weak spot against the league.

note: Bryant is not a draft target in our league. He is ranked 306 on Yahoo and 296 on ESPN at 0 USD, well outside the 144 players drafted, and in about 12 minutes a game he gives little outside a low TO count. He is a waiver handcuff: if Allen or Mobley miss time, he is the only real backup big, so add him then. Early on, check how often he plays and his FG%, because Yahoo projects 42.6% and ESPN 50.7%.
